name: wigolo
cost: Free (AGPL-3.0) for the core tools. Companies are asked to buy a commercial licence or sponsor
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Antigravity and any MCP client
short: A local web search, fetch and crawl server for coding agents, with ten tools, no API keys and a local cache of everything it reads.
what: wigolo is an MCP server that gives your agent ten web tools: search, fetch, crawl, cache, extract, find similar, research, agent-driven gathering, page diffs and change watching. Ranking, embeddings and the browser engine run on your machine, and results are kept in a local cache under `~/.wigolo/`. It has no built-in LLM. Your agent writes the final answer from the evidence it returns, or you can give it an LLM key for research answers.
who: Anyone who wants web search and page reading in their coding agent without a paid search API. It needs about 1.5 GB of disk. It is in public beta.
needs: Node 20 or later (the README recommends an LTS, Node 22 or 24)
About 1.5 GB of free disk on macOS, Linux or Windows
Optional: an LLM key (Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI or Groq) or a local Ollama for written research answers

steps.title: Set it up and wire your agents
steps.text: Downloads the browser engine and on-device models, runs a health check, and writes the MCP config for the agents you name.

steps.title: Or add it by hand
steps.text: In Claude Code. Other clients register `npx wigolo` in their MCP config.
steps.code: claude mcp add wigolo -- npx wigolo

steps.title: Optional: written answers for research
steps.text: `research`, `agent` and `search format=answer` hand back a raw brief without an LLM. Set a provider to get a finished answer, or use `WIGOLO_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama` to stay local.

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text: Ask it to fetch only the Parameters section of https://react.dev/reference/react/useState, or to search react.dev for "react server components patterns" in docs.

watch: With `use_auth: true`, `fetch` and `crawl` reuse your browser session, so they can read pages behind your logins.
With an LLM provider key set, `research`, `agent` and `search format=answer` use that provider to write their answers.
`watch` can deliver changes to a webhook you give it.
To remove everything, run `npx wigolo config --uninstall --yes`.
Public beta. Some challenge-protected sites block datacenter IPs.
